biography.value:
Description

A nearly naked woman with pointy ears and long extended feathers for wings on her back.

Defense

AC 21, touch 16, flat-footed 14 (+5 natural, +7 dex, -1 size)

hp 150 [204] (12d10+84)

mp 57

Fort +14, Ref +15, Will +13

DR 10/evil; Immune Bleed, Curse, Daze, Death Effects, Holy, Mind-affecting, Outsider traits, Paralyze, Petrification/Statue, Silence, Stun; Resist Lightning 20, Fire 20, Ice 20; SR 22;

Offense

Speed 40 ft.; Fly 120 ft. (average)

Melee Slam +16 (1d6+5)

Ranged Power Staff: Holy +18 (1d6+7 holy)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Sanctified

Spells Known (FC CL 8th, Concentration +19)

At will (DC 17) - Bleed, Holy Orb, Mending, Read Magic

1st (DC 18) - Aero, Blizzard, Fire, Thunder

2nd (DC 19) - Aero II, Blizzard II, Fire II, Thunder II

3rd (DC 20) - Aera, Aero III, Blizzara, Blizzard III, Fira, Fire III, Thundara, Thunder III

4th (DC 21) - Aero IV, Blizzard IV, Fire IV, Thunder IV

Statistics

Str 20, Dex 24, Con 22, Int 14, Wis 25, Cha 20

Base Atk +12; CMB +18; CMD 25

Feats Extra MP, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Spell Penetration, Toughness

Skills Appraise +17, Bluff +15, Fly +20, Knowledge (Arcana) +17, Knowledge (Planes) +17, Perception +22, Sense Motive +22, Spellcraft +17

Languages Celestial

Gear holy power staff
